room_bathroom.text: Only giving one towel for 2 adults room was poor, hope they will fix it.
don’t deserve the money you payed for, no hot water wasn’t working , no phone in the room to call the reception , no safe no wardrobe

No hot water in the bathroom - a quick apology is what I got. The shower head in room 745 had a leak and dropped all day/night long. Pillows were tall and hard - not conducive of a restful sleep. Breakfast buffet is the only option for almost 12€ even if you just want a cup of coffee. Breakfast people overflows to the lobby area making it very busy and noisy. Staff seemed overwhelmed both during check in and check out times. A very disappointing stay., Hotel sits on a main road so it’s well connected. Room and bathroom were well cleaned.

We arrived after midnight, we booked a room for 2 person, but we got a single room only, one towel, one blanket.... Was not so comfortable. We called the reception, but nothing happened, we just got a sorry in morning.

It is a scandalous to rate this hotel as high the way it appears in the booking site after so many customer complains. As for our 3 night stay - NO hot water for a night and a morning after before a most important meeting in the three days of our stay. The staff didn't do anything (except some artificial smiles which actually were expression of arogance and rudeness) We have been waiting for an answer (as was promised) from the manager on the compensation that we deserve to get ....until now not even an apology! As consistent customer of booking - I am disappointed with you guys . I can't rely on your " trustful" rating ... (You hide the negative responses and you don't highlight enough the negative responses - apparently you don't play any role in pushing such institution as this to improve. I will have to consider to switch to another supplier!, The location

The internet didn't work during my whole stay and although I kept asking for assistance at the front desk (no phone in the rooms to solve these issues) the problem persisted. The worst is that I had to explain myself as if it was me who was doing something wrong when the internet did't work in any of my three devices. So I kept repeating the same explanations to different people in the front desk who did nothing to solve the problem. Quite annoying experience, I must say, especially when the internet is the only "extra" service that this hotel offers., Comfortable bed in a somewhat austere cadre that offers you strictly what you need to get some rest. No extras of any kind (no kettle in the rooms or phone or wardrobe or safe or room service or any other amenity that may make your life easier). Only recommended if you're going to Brussels for work and planning to spend most of the time out of hotel and just go there to sleep.
